"""Adopt the isolated rebase of one unpublished commit, without checking out files."""
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
old='e59a09b9f939afae28e718f2cca3d53728ffd45b';new='ab128f0719e20b986280308bf6b89af59cb43b63';public_base='d2bd73ef48ecad7cf491326c6e366aa09c2a89b9'
receipt_path=ROOT/'runtime/checkpoint-resumed-low-v7-auto-2-rebased-20261025.json';published=read_json(receipt_path)
assert published['commit']==new and published['original_failed_commit']==old
assert published['status'] in ['committed_and_pushed','committed_pushed_and_originals_verified']
validation=read_json(ROOT/published['rebase_validation']);assert validation['validated_commit']==new and validation['all_remote_and_task_tree_changes_preserved']
def git(*args,env=None):
 r=subprocess.run(['git','-c','gc.auto=0',*args],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,env={**os.environ,'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0',**(env or {})},timeout=180)
 assert r.returncode==0,(args,r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'),r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
 return r.stdout
assert git('symbolic-ref','HEAD').decode().strip()=='refs/heads/master'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==old
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only',old).strip(),'Preserve staged work'
assert git('rev-parse',old+'^').decode().strip()==public_base
git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',public_base,new)
observed=git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/master').decode().split()[0]
if observed!=new:
 git('fetch','origin');git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',new,observed)
gitdir=Path(git('rev-parse','--absolute-git-dir').decode().strip());index=gitdir/'index';lock=gitdir/'index.lock'
assert all(not (gitdir/p).exists() for p in ['rebase-merge','rebase-apply','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD'])
folder=ROOT/'runtime/low-v7-primary-private-rebase-adoption-20261025';folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
alternate=folder/'published.index';env={'GIT_INDEX_FILE':str(alternate)}
git('read-tree',new,env=env)
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only',new,env=env).strip()
before=index.read_bytes();replacement=alternate.read_bytes();(folder/'original.index').write_bytes(before)
audit=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261025-v7-private-rebase-primary-adoption.json';assert not audit.exists()
record={'machine_id':machine_id(),'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'status':'prepared_no_primary_mutation','old_private_commit':old,'published_rebased_commit':new,'old_public_parent':public_base,'remote_master_observed':observed,'publication_receipt':receipt_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'publication_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(receipt_path),'rebase_validation':published['rebase_validation'],'original_index_backup':(folder/'original.index').relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'original_index_sha256':hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),'new_index_sha256':hashlib.sha256(replacement).hexdigest(),'source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'scope':'Metadata-only adoption of the actual isolated rebase of a single unpublished private task commit, after ordinary FF public push. All public ancestry retained; no worktree checkout, stash, reset, public history rewrite or force push. Original index backed up, primary index lock and conditional ref update protect concurrent staged/ref work. Raw remote readback is independent and not claimed complete here.'}
write_json(audit,record)
fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY);owns_lock=True;ref_updated=False
try:
 assert index.read_bytes()==before and git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==old
 assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only',old).strip()
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as out:
  fd=None;out.write(replacement);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
 git('update-ref','-m','Adopt validated isolated rebase of unpublished LOW snapshot','refs/heads/master',new,old)
 ref_updated=True
 os.replace(lock,index);owns_lock=False
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==new
 assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only',new).strip()
 record.update(status='published_private_rebase_adopted_metadata_only',completed_at_utc=utc_now(),actual_primary_HEAD=new,actual_index_sha256=file_sha256(index),staged_diff_empty=True)
except BaseException:
 record.update(status='needs_explicit_reconciliation',observed_at_utc=utc_now(),conditional_ref_update_succeeded=ref_updated,primary_head_observed=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip(),primary_index_sha256=file_sha256(index))
 raise
finally:
 if fd is not None:os.close(fd)
 if owns_lock and lock.exists():lock.unlink()
 write_json(audit,record)
print(json.dumps({'status':record['status'],'HEAD':new,'primary_working_files_written':0,'audit':audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()},ensure_ascii=True))
